saltPolicy: Public deterministic uint256 user salts, subject to approval and empty-address prediction checks; no fallback reuse or silent substitution

registrationSecret.generator: future crypto.getRandomValues only after authorization; not generated now
registrationSecret.storage: memory only; never localStorage, public journal or Git
registrationSecret.lossPolicy: stop if lost; wait commitment expiration then separately review a new attempt; encrypted recovery is a separate owner decision
registrationSecret.distinction: This is a commit/reveal preimage, never a MetaMask seed/private key

expiry.reference: latest identified review block after ancestors confirmed; uint64 absolute expiries; no silent clamping

spending.approval: exact fresh quoted units only, no unlimited approval
spending.priceChange: stop for a new quote/allowance/review, even below cap

fees.policy: Ceilings, not fee targets. Resolve RPC quote/estimate for every exact packet; do not silently cap failing estimates

confirmations.policy: both 12 confirmations and receipt height covered by finalized header, same canonical hash; revalidate ancestors and current state before every next packet

noncePolicy: one owner sender; no concurrent unrelated owner transactions; explicit retry/replacement review only
decisionsRequired: 8.1 MockUSDC rent cap and exact-quote approval policy
12 confirmations plus finalized and reorg policy
independent review and explicit future live authorization
